answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1576 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the garden. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the yarrow queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 249 pays that 84 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
